steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Prepare brownie mix: Stir brownie mix, water, oil, and eggs in a medium bowl until well blended. Spread evenly into the prepared pan.

Prepare cheesecake topping: Beat together cream cheese, egg, and sugar using an electric mixer until smooth. Dollop the cream cheese mixture on top of the brownie batter. Swirl together using a knife or skewer.
Bake in the preheated oven for 22 to 25 minutes. Brownies will be done when a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool in the pan, then cut into 24 squares and serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Cheesecake Brownies
raw_recipe.description: These easy cheesecake brownies take boxed brownie mix and add a simple cream cheese topping for a treat that tastes fancy but comes together quickly.

video.description: These cheesecake brownies are so festive and perfect for the holiday season! Fluffy, chocolaty, and extra decadent with a layer of colorful cheesecake! Bring to your next holiday party for a great dessert, guaranteed to be a hit!

review.reviewBody: Awesome idea and pretty too. I usually put 2/3 of the brownie batter into the pan first, then ALL of the cream cheese on top, then add remaining brownie batter. This way, it makes a nice swirl, and not too white on top. I sometimes use a 9-inch springform pan to make this then cut into pie wedges and garnish with fresh strawberry slices for an easy, attractive, elegant dessert.

OMG! These were sooo good! I used 2 pkgs of supreme brownie mix, because i love thick brownies. I added 1 tsp of vanilla to the cream cheese mixture, and 3 tbs of butter, and 1 tbs of flour, it really helps with the texture. Definately use parchement paper to line the pan to prevent sticking or tough edges. soo delicious, much easier this way and just as good as the "from scratch" method! thx!

Excellent picnic brownies. I added 2 T of sour cream to the topping mixture as well as 1 tsp of vanilla. I stirred about 1/2 C of sea salt chips into the brownie mixture and then also spread some on top, more as decoration, about 8 minutes before baking was done. I under baked a little too - so they were very moist. The mix of flavors was scrumptious! Great reviews at the picnic.
I made these in a cupcake / muffin pan for easy serving and used a ready made cheesecake filling to make this even easier.

Super yummy!! I used a dark chocolate fudge brownie mix and a berry flavored cream cheese this time and did the 1/3 brownie batter on top of the cheesecake filling (the way I've made it before) and then dropped strawberry preserves on top of the brownie before swirling.. I also added a few milk chocolate chips after it baked and then put it back in the oven long enough to get the chips melty.... Heavenly!!!

I love making cheesecake brownies, especially for work birthdays (huge hit!). A couple helpful tips - make sure your ingredients are at room temperature.. they will mix better. Start with cream cheese and sugar, beat for 1 minute, then add the egg and mix for another minute. I like to add some vanilla extract for extra flavor, and top with crumbled Oreos / chocolate morsels / nuts. Similar to other comments, I add 2/3 of the brownie batter into the (aluminum lined / PAM sprayed) pan, dollop and swirl with cheesecake filling, then top with remaining brownie batter.

This recipe is the gold standard at my house. I do add 1 TBL of flour and a spec more sugar to the cream cheese mix as many reviewers suggested . Honestly, these are even better the second day (but they often don't last that long). Cook until the cream cheese is set - but not yet brown. Amazing!
Added tsp of vanilla and 1 cup chocolate chips to cream cheese mixture.
Kids want me to make these weekly they are definitely a hit in my household. We like them thicker though so i just use a round glass dish and cook them for about 35 minutes.

This recipe is so simple to make. I added 4oz cream cheese, 1 more egg & 1 tsp vanilla extract. I used 2 boxed brownies since i like it to be thicker and added chopped cashew nuts. Sooo yummy! Will bring it to my husband’s family on the weekend! For sure they will love it too.

My son wanted this for his birthday, instead of cake. Turned out amazingly moist and delicious!
A few swaps... I made double. I used one less egg than the brownie mix and recipe required (total 6 needed, used 5), 12 oz cream cheese, 2/3 cup of sugar.

So Yummy! Oh and the kiddo loved them!

I made the brownie mix according to the recipe on the box. They came out beautiful and very yummy. We added ice cream to a warm brownie for a extra treat! Will be making this recipe frequently as it was so easy and quick to make.
I also made it in a spring form round pan and swirled the remainder of brownie batter on the cheese cake batter and swirled on top.
Great extra special brownies. I used Ghiardellie Brownie mix as the base. Doubled the whole recipe for a family dinner. Everyone raved about them.
Brownies came out very cakey. I couldn't really taste the cream cheese. Good but not what I was hoping for
Turned out great!! Looks good too!! (just like the picture)!! Delicious!!!
Super easy and just as good. I did what another reviewer wrote, I saved some of the fudge mix and spread it on top of the cheese cake mix then swirled. DELISH
